title: No, Puzzle Games Aren't Dead, You Just Didn't Realise They're Emotional Experiences Too
prompt: Build an emotion-driven puzzle game where the player solves deduction logic grids but the real score is their emotional response — hovering over cells reveals a subtle heartbeat animation, and solving the grid triggers an emotional impact label (Satisfaction, Relief, Epiphany, Frustration). Mechanics include nonogram-style binary deduction and a post-solve reflection card. Understated, gallery-white minimal aesthetic with soft sound-wave animations.
